description: This file defines classes and structures for creating and managing dialog boxes in the CKEditor framework, including dialog definitions, content pages, buttons, and UI elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.dialogDefinition
classes.description: Class representing the dialog's properties such as title, size, contents, and event handlers.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.contentDefinition
classes.description: Class representing individual content pages within a dialog, including id, label, access key, and elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.buttonDefinition
classes.description: Class representing dialog buttons, including id, label, access key, disabled state, and click handler.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.uiElementDefinition
classes.description: Class representing UI elements within dialog content, including id, type, style, and event handlers.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.add
methods.description: Function to add a new dialog definition to the CKEditor instance.
